svg.text: Each slot takes Pear's matching hue (cool ones blended in at Pear's saturation and value), then leans 10% toward its lime.
HUE AND CHROMA (OKLab a/b; ring: Default, dot: this palette)
Pear's neutrals mapped by role: a warm olive-brown dark, a cream light. Follows the accent's hue.
The ramp turns by the accent's OK hue minus green's, holding each key's luminance; a tint band scales its chroma by where it lands.
no tint band: full tint at every hue
chroma kept (of authored), by the OK hue the ground lands on; dots are the accents
tint band: center 85°, flat 10°, fall 50°, floor 0.45
chroma kept (of authored), by the OK hue the ground lands on; dots are the accents
